capture.hide_gui_source: measured from the goldens: all 157 frames have no hearts, hotbar or crosshair; Malmo ClientStateMachine forces hideGUI=true for the mission, which qrl_launch.hide_gui does not record
capture.hand_from_tick_source: first golden at which MAGMA's held item is right, not the tick the oracle's hand returns - the oracle draws a viewmodel throughout (at t=1140..1220 it fills the lower-right corner with a held block, pixel-identical across a 60 degree yaw sweep, that magma does not have). The tape rows carry no inv field; magma's only inventory is two set_inventory rows in the worldpatch sidecar, t=2274 (item 58) and t=2320 (item 269, slot 6), and t=2440 is the first golden after that. Confirmed by replaying the tape hand-on and hand-off and scoring the lower-right quadrant of all 157 goldens: hand-off wins through t=2420, hand-on from t=2440 (8.00/ch vs 1.63/ch). Extending the sidecar moves this tick
